flows.title: Translate a file
steps: On the web translator, click Translate files.
Select a file from your computer, or drag and drop it into the translator window.
Select one or more target languages.
Optionally select a glossary, a formal or informal tone, or a language model. The formality option is hidden when more than one target language is selected.
Click the Start translations button, then click Download.
Each target language uses one file translation from the monthly count.

flows.title: Translate a PDF and get a Word document back
steps: Upload one or more PDF files.
Optionally apply a glossary or formality, or change the language model.
On an Advanced, Ultimate, Team, Business or Enterprise plan, select Convert all to Word documents (.docx) in the new window, then click Translate file.
With several files at once, select Choose individual format per files to pick a format for each one.
